placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
AirHop Bristol is an option for families who want a more active indoor day. Choose a session that fits your children rather than assuming every activity is suitable for everyone.

Our family idea: book a session together and build in time to arrive, change and hear the briefing. Plan a drink and a slower-paced break afterwards.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Active children, with the right age-specific session.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Indoor trampoline activities and an on-site cafe.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Use the venue's directions to its Cribbs Causeway site and check parking arrangements before travel.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Book the correct session and check age, height, supervision, grip-sock and waiver requirements. Individual attractions may have different restrictions.
